standard.summary: 每 N 步在验证集上评估 loss，用于检测过拟合（训练 loss 下降但验证 loss 上升）。
standard.effect: 开启后每 N 步暂停训练，在 eval_data_dir 的验证集上计算 loss（不更新权重）。可以早期发现过拟合。
standard.whenToUse: 有独立验证集（与训练集图像不重叠）时使用。验证集通常取训练集的 10%~20%。
standard.avoidWhen: LoRA 训练数据集通常很小（<50张），难以分出有效验证集；多数 LoRA 训练不使用正式验证集（用预览图目测代替）。

standard_en.summary: Evaluates the loss on the validation set every N steps, to detect overfitting (the training loss falling while the validation loss rises).
standard_en.effect: Once enabled, training pauses every N steps to compute the loss on the validation set in eval_data_dir (without updating weights). It catches overfitting early.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use it when you have a separate validation set (images that do not overlap the training set). A validation set is usually 10%~20% of the training set.
standard_en.avoidWhen: A LoRA training dataset is usually very small (<50 images), which makes an effective validation split hard; most LoRA training uses no formal validation set (judging preview images by eye instead).

advanced.principle: 验证评估仅计算 forward pass 的 loss（torch.no_grad()），不计算梯度，速度快且不影响权重。max_validation_steps 限制验证集的最大评估批次数（大验证集时避免过长暂停）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 验证 loss 是比训练 loss 更可信的过拟合指标；但 LoRA 的目标通常是主观质量而非 loss 数值，单纯追踪 loss 可能与实际生成质量不完全对应。

advanced_en.principle: Validation computes only the forward pass's loss (torch.no_grad()) without gradients — fast and it does not touch the weights. max_validation_steps limits the maximum number of evaluated batches from the validation set (avoids overly long pauses with big validation sets).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Validation loss is a more trustworthy overfitting metric than training loss; but a LoRA's goal is usually subjective quality rather than a loss number, so tracking loss alone may not fully correspond to actual generation quality.
